key_insight: Vision LLMs paired with classical computer vision can recover calibrated PXRD curves from published COF figures as reusable experimental data.
engineering_relevance: Digitized diffraction curves enable analysis of peak prominence across synthesis conditions, potentially supporting crystallinity assessment and synthesis optimization.
method: Use a vision LLM to locate diffraction plots and individual curves.
Generate coarse curve traces, then refine them to pixel-level accuracy with classical computer vision.
Calibrate extracted curves and release them in the open COF-PEAK database.
evidence_signal: Processing 3,954 COF articles yielded 11,445 calibrated curves; comparison with hand digitization of 60 panels found a median peak-position difference of 0.07°.
watch_item: The 60-panel evaluation may not capture all figure formats, and peak prominence remains only a possible marker of crystallinity.
paper_title: Structured Extraction of Diffraction Data from Covalent Organic Frameworks
